bullets.text: Imgur Blocks UK Users - **Imgur** restricts access to UK users amid ICO investigation, effective September 30, 2025.
Granola's New Feature - **Granola** introduces repeatable prompts, enhancing note-taking efficiency for users.
Amazon's AI Kindle Feature - **Amazon** unveils an AI feature in Kindle Scribe to enhance reading comprehension.
Wikipedia Data for AI - **Wikimedia** launches a project to make Wikipedia data more accessible to AI models.
Wikidata's AI-Friendly Database - **Wikidata** enhances its database for easier access by AI developers.
Roland's TR-1000 Launch - **Roland** introduces its first analog drum machine in over 40 years, the TR-1000.
US Invests in Lithium - The **U.S. Department of Energy** takes stakes in **Lithium Americas** to boost domestic supply.
South Korea's Cybersecurity Crisis - South Korea faces ongoing cybersecurity breaches, raising concerns about digital defenses.
FTC Targets Sendit App - The **FTC** alleges **Sendit** illegally collected children's data and misled users.
OpenAI's Sora Launch - **OpenAI** debuts the Sora app, a TikTok competitor with advanced video generation features.
